files.reason: Companies House company-profile lookup by registration number: GET /company/{company_number} with the API key as the HTTP Basic username when COMPANIES_HOUSE_API_KEY is set, recorded responses labelled test data otherwise; maps company_status dissolved or liquidation and accounts.next_accounts.overdue to material Declared vs found findings, and 404, errors or timeouts to couldn't check
Recorded Companies House company-profile responses used without an API key; 09318842 is late with its accounts, plus an active, a dissolved and a liquidation profile

Add the check_companies_house KYC action through executeIntent: companies_house_check_on denies while kyc.companies_house_check is 0 so cases stay unchanged, uk_business_case denies non-UK and consumer cases; apply writes the company_registry check and Companies House rows to kyc_discrepancies; approval stays held by the existing declared_vs_found rule; add rule labels and fields
Document the optional server-only COMPANIES_HOUSE_API_KEY and that without it the check uses recorded test data

Cover setting off leaves cases unchanged, UK business only, recorded test data, 09318842 late with accounts held for a manager, active, dissolved, liquidation, failed lookup, live Basic auth, refused live connection, key never stored, and re-running without duplicates or new approve rules
Asserts kyc_0104 approves straight through with zero material differences and approve's exact rule order; both must still hold with the setting off, modified only if one of those assertions moves

Asserts refused actions, input validation and that no seeded approved case breaks the approval rules; the new check_companies_house action joins the KYC action list, modified only if an assertion moves
Iterates every KYC action asserting engineers get forbidden_role; check_companies_house joins that loop, modified only if the assertion moves

reuses.reason: The lookup is a KYC action on the single governed write path, so it is validated, policy-checked, audited and idempotent like every other write
Material Companies House rows are held for a KYC manager by the existing declared_vs_found rule; approve gains no new rule
CheckResult, KycDiscrepancy and the live materialDifferences count carry the result to the Checks and Declared vs found panels
Results are stored in the existing kyc_checks and kyc_discrepancies tables; no migration
kyc.companies_house_check is the setting the KYC tool already declares with default 0; rules read it fresh on every evaluation and admins change it in rule settings

acceptance: with kyc.companies_house_check off, checking Companies House is denied and the case is unchanged
only UK business cases are checked; consumer and non-UK cases are denied
without COMPANIES_HOUSE_API_KEY the recorded response is used and labelled test data
09318842 is late with its accounts and declared_vs_found holds approval for a manager
an active company with its accounts up to date clears the registry check and adds no row
a dissolved company adds a material Declared vs found row
a company in liquidation adds a material Declared vs found row
a failed lookup marks the registry check needs review and keeps earlier findings
with COMPANIES_HOUSE_API_KEY the lookup sends the key by Basic auth to the company profile and is not test data
the live transport reports a refused connection as couldn't check
the API key never reaches the case file or the audit trail
re-running the check replaces its own rows and approve gains no new rule
